name: The Great Calamity: Satella Consumes Half the World
description: Due to incompatibility with the Envy Witch Factor, Satella undergoes catastrophic mental bifurcation. The Witch of Envy rampages across the continents, obliterating almost half the globe.

name: The Sealing of the Witch of Envy at Pleiades Watchtower
description: Unable to kill the immortal Witch, Flugel, Reid Astrea, and Volcanica combine their legendary might to seal Satella inside a shrine in the eastern sand sea, placing Shaula and divine oaths on guard.

name: Fall of the Six Witches & The Dream World Soul Harvest
description: The remaining Witches perish one by one in the wake of the disaster. Echidna collects their soul essences into her Dream Castle before her own physical demise.

name: Establishment of the Dragon Covenant
description: The Divine Dragon Volcanica enters into a sacred alliance with the first King of Lugunica, bestowing the Dragon Stone, divine protection, and founding the Dragon Kingdom.

name: Alec Hoshin Founds the Merchant Republic of Kararagi
description: Alec Hoshin migrates west, introduces commercial trade agreements, infrastructure, Kansai-style culture, and organizes independent city-states into the unified merchant federation of Kararagi.

name: The First Roswaal's Soul-Transference Bloodline Oath
description: Roswaal A. Mathers commences a forbidden soul-possession ritual across successive generations of bloodline descendants, dedicated entirely to reviving Echidna.

name: Stabilization of the Great Waterfall and Sand Seas
description: The planetary scar left behind by the Great Calamity freezes the borders of the flat world, forming the deadly Augria Sand Dunes and permanent cascades of the Great Waterfall.

name: Destruction of the Southern Vollachian Borderlands
description: Shadows from the Witch of Envy ravage the early settlements of the Vollachia Empire, permanently reshaping its militaristic doctrine of absolute strength to survive existential threats.

name: Reid Astrea Cleaves the Atmospheric Miasma
description: Using only ordinary wooden sticks and overwhelming physical mastery, first Sword Saint Reid Astrea slices space itself to bisect the raging miasma storms surrounding the dragon's lair.
